title: The Quinean Continuity: Operationalizing Philosophy (RSA Section 11)
summary: This document presents the final theoretical chapter of a Recursive Semantic Alignment (RSA) framework, arguing that philosophy should be operationalized as recursive epistemic engineering following Quine's continuity thesis. It maps classical logic types (cosmological, teleological, moral, ontological, modal, theological) onto specific variance-compression operations within a unified RSA kernel, and defines worldviews as recursive update loops converging map to territory.
invariants: recursion is the engine of alignment
compression is lossy and must be tracked
semantic tension must be minimized not eliminated
no agent achieves zero error at finite cost
the map is not the territory but convergence is the obligation
